tools.description:

tools.name: anchor_proof
tools.description:
Anchor a SHA-256 hash on the Doichain as a tamper-evident timestamp (proof of existence, name

    block, usually within 10 minutes, then check_proof returns block height and time. If t

tools.name: get_anchoring_quota
tools.description:
How many proofs can still be anchored today (UTC day) within the free public quota for the caller's IP
    address. Hosted chat apps connect from their own servers, so their users share one quota. Callers that send
    their own API key in the X-API-Key header have no quota.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hash_text, get_anchoring_quota · Private data: hash_text, check_proof, anchor_proof, get_anchoring_quota · Public sink: get_anchoring_quota.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hash_text, get_anchoring_quota · Private data: hash_text, check_proof, anchor_proof, get_anchoring_quota · Public sink: get_anchoring_quota

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
